Production environment background for an existing colorful side-view 2D pixel-art fighting game. WIDE 16:9 panoramic composition, sharp hand-authored stepped pixel clusters, restrained 32/64-color palette, broad readable shapes, dark outlines and simple cel-shaded surfaces. Match clean 1990s arcade scenery, no photorealism, no 3D render, no blur, no excessive microtexture. Camera is side-on at fighter height, fixed horizon, no fisheye or tilted camera. Environment ONLY: no characters, silhouettes of people, enemies, animals, fighters, foreground props, lettering, text, logos, UI, borders or watermark. Compose for a 1280x720 arena: a clear flat horizontal fighting ground has its foot/contact line at y=578 (80.3 percent image height), with empty low-contrast foreground extending to bottom; keep the central play area from x=80 to1200, y=330 to600 free of clutter that would occlude fighters. Strong landmarks belong in the middle/far background above the fighting lane. Keep upper 22 percent fairly dark/simple for HUD legibility. Frame the left and right corners as equally walkable. No giant objects or pillars in the foreground. Rich layered scenic depth with controlled contrast so fighters remain the focus. One seamless single complete background image.

SCENE: A muddy maintenance trench at the foot of a huge distant neon city. Side-on fighting lane at the bottom, metal retaining walls, drainage pipes, shallow rain puddles, a broken amber work lamp and an unlettered discarded access pass on a wall hook. The trench opens to a hazy staircase and a narrow distant route up toward glittering city towers. Rainy predawn blue/teal air against amber lamp pools. Humble starting-line mood with visible hope in the city lights. Foreground level packed-earth lane; puddles behind the combat foot line, no water blocking the walkable floor.

A branching route of small red, blue, gold and green lights approaches the portal from below, suggesting every recruited crew member.
